description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key with SpaceNexus Research. Search federal space contracts and IDV vehicles ending within the next 24 months: incumbent recipient, UEI, company slug, awarding agency, obligated dollars, end date, PSC/NAICS codes and USAspending record URLs. Filter by agency, incumbent, horizon and minimum value.

incumbent.description: Incumbent company name, slug or UEI substring.

limit.description: How many contracts to return (1 to 25).

min_amount_usd.description: Minimum obligated amount in US dollars.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging (0 to 10000).

name: recompete_radar_search
title: Recompete radar search
